traits.note: Gleason and Cronquist's account of the genus, as quoted in search results (the page itself was not read): plants dioecious or nearly so, their heads disciform or discoid; involucral bracts overlapping, almost wholly dry and papery; receptacle naked, flat or convex.

traits.life_span.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Anaphalis (p. 485): tomentose perennial herbs with running, branching rootstocks.

traits.woodiness.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Anaphalis (p. 485): perennial herbs.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Anaphalis (p. 485): leaves alternate, the lowest scale-like, the rest lanceolate to linear.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Anaphalis (p. 485): leaves entire.

traits.sexual_system.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Anaphalis (p. 485): heads dioecious or polygamodioecious: some plants bear heads of sterile hermaphrodite florets, others heads of many pistillate florets with about 4 fertile hermaphrodite ones.

traits.pappus.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Anaphalis (p. 485): pappus of soft bristles.

traits.disc_colour.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Anaphalis (p. 485): corollas yellowish. Word: yellowish.

traits.rhizome_habit.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Anaphalis (p. 485): running, branching rootstocks; species (p. 485): from slender running rootstocks.
